reuse.why: Extends the existing isNonWorkingDay predicate, which every holiday-aware path (getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, schedule-template, getDateWithSkippedWeekend) already calls, and reuses monthUtils.dayFromDate.

duplication.why: The recurring-day check is added once inside the shared predicate; nothing is copied.

placement.why: Holiday matching belongs in shared/schedules.ts isNonWorkingDay, where the tree already decides it; the format is documented on the RecurConfig type.

scope.why: One predicate, a type doc comment, a focused test and a release note.

maintainability.why: Small, readable change in the single place that interprets holidays; only nit is that the holidayMargin in schedules/app.ts still counts list entries, which no longer bounds recurring entries.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All holiday checks go through isNonWorkingDay.
